text:
Jordan Park: Quick heads-up — during testing I noticed the Prompt Sets run list on 800px width collapses to a long vertical list and the regression diff preview gets pushed off-screen. Screenshot attached. :eyes:
Lina Gomez: Ugh yep saw that. On narrow screens the run preview panel is taking the full width. Can we collapse the preview into a hover/peek instead of a full row?
Jordan Park: Hover peek could work, but keyboard users need a persistent open state. Maybe a collapsible accordion with `aria-expanded` and focus trap when opened?
Priya Shah: Agree on accordion. For screen readers we should expose a concise summary in the list item, like: `Run #42 — 12 tests, 3 changed`. That way SR users get the gist without opening.
Samir Patel: Also want to flag the scorecard CTA — the primary action copy currently reads "Approve changes" which feels final. Suggest "Review & approve" to set expectation you can still undo.
Lina Gomez: +1 on copy tweak. "Approve changes" sounds destructive. "Finalize approval" would be worse.
Jordan Park: Accessibility nit: when you open the regression diff, focus should move into the diff pane and ESC should close it and return focus to the originating run row. Right now focus stays on the approve button.
design-bot: Reminder: color contrast check failed for `.diff-flag` (ratio 3.8:1) — needs >= 4.5:1 for small text.
Priya Shah: For the flag we can bump the weight or use a slightly darker orange. Let's avoid using color alone for status — add an icon and visually-hidden text like "Changed: 3".
Samir Patel: UX question: when multiple runs are selected and user hits approve, do we show a single modal summarizing all diffs or walk through them one-by-one?
Lina Gomez: For safety, modal with a short digest + inline preview thumbs. Offer "Review individually" link from modal. Keeps flow fast for power users but prevents accidental bulk approvals.
Jordan Park: Can we also add an explicit list of which models/weights the run used? There have been confusions where people approved a run from an unintended model variant.
Priya Shah: Yes, show a compact metadata row: model name, quantization, seed, eval run id. Make each label focusable and announceable.
Samir Patel: Interaction nit: when a run has a failing test, the row should pin a persistent inline pill "1 failing" that links straight to the failing test — not buried in the preview.
Lina Gomez: Layout idea: two-column responsive grid. Left column: run list (60% on wide, 100% on narrow), right: preview drawer that slides up from bottom on narrow screens. Drawer gets `role=dialog` and proper labeling.
Jordan Park: Prototype looks promising. Quick CSS suggestion for slide-up drawer: `transform: translateY(100%); transition: transform 240ms ease;` and on open `transform: translateY(0);` — keeps GPU-accelerated.
design-bot: Accessibility checklist added to PR template: focus management, aria labels for dynamic content, keyboard shortcuts documented.
Priya Shah: One more copy micro-nit: in the approval modal the secondary action currently says "Cancel" — change to "Back to review" to reduce ambiguity.
Samir Patel: Frontend dev note: need endpoints to return `run.summary_text` and `run.accessibility_labels` in the run list API to avoid additional round trips.
Lina Gomez: I'll update the mocks and add a11y annotations. Jordan, can you sketch the keyboard flow and send screenshots of the prototype?
Jordan Park: Yep, will upload a short Loom and a keyboard flow diagram today. :thumbsup:
Priya Shah: Awesome. If we align on accordion + drawer + copy changes I'll draft the design token contrast options and small/large text specs.
Samir Patel: Thanks all — will hold off on merging approval modal until mock + API updates are ready.
Jordan Park: Great sync — filing a small follow-up ticket for the copy and contrast changes.
Lina Gomez: Love it. :tada:
